tests.note: Chi2 on 20-tag x 4-type table of summed per-video topic-share points (75 videos; per-question tags are not stored in-repo — see data_deviation). H4 segmentation confirmed only if p<0.05 AND V>0.2 (design threshold): confirmed=True. Cluster bootstrap CI over videos. Permutation null within year strata (reliable-year videos, n=40): chi2=572.1, permutation p=0.0001, asymptotic p=4.042e-86, V=0.218. The headline asymptotic p (1e-175) is DECORATIVE as count inference — cells are pipeline-estimated share points with massive pseudo-replication — and must never be quoted without this caveat (advisor ruling §3). The operative evidence is: V=0.212 clears the pre-registered 0.2 threshold narrowly (bias-corrected 0.206 does not), the cluster bootstrap CI clears it entirely, and the within-year-strata permutation p=0.0001 is robust to the row-independence problem. P3 confirms digest-level topical segmentation by packaging format, NOT question-level demand.

Binomial GLM of disclosure-topic share on year, reliable-year videos 2024-2026 (n=34 videos, 556 questions). One-sided slope>0 plus monotone fitted shares: monotone=False; confirmed=False. Frozen base rate: 16.8%.

One-sided Jonckheere–Terpstra on per-claim c_i across ordinal Delta bins (n=88); permutation p (10k, seed 42). Pooled C per bin is descriptive only. Ratchet signature REJECTED (p=0.9483, Somers D=-0.309); the observed direction is flat-to-falling, consistent with the pre-registered null shape (r2_design §1a: honest forecasting predicts flat or falling conditionality near resolution). The negative trend is weak, era-fragile, and carried by the 5-10y bin (n=3); see p1_direction_summary for the E2/E3 distinction. A rejected H1 is a null result for the ratchet hypothesis, NOT a confirmed alternative (advisor ruling §2).

CI-based per design: drift >= 1.0 means the deadline recedes at least as fast as time passes (ratchet signature). n=25 restated contact-window bounds; slope_U 95% CI [-1.50, 3.00]. Each point is a restatement of a contact window in a reliable-date video (deduplicated per video/bounds).

policy: Holm step-down across the 4 primary tests; P2 is CI-based and enters with its CI verdict (design §2).
